question: An article is sold for ₹452.20, after allowing three successive discounts of 20%, 30% and 5%. If a single discount of 55% is given on the marked price, then its selling price (in ₹) will be:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the Marked Price (MP) be 100%.

Equivalent SP % after successive 20%, 30%, and 5% discounts = 100% × 0.80 × 0.70 × 0.95 = 53.2%.

Given 53.2% of MP = ₹452.20.

SP after a single 55% discount = 100% − 55% = 45% of MP.

Required SP = (452.20 ÷ 53.2) × 45 = 8.5 × 45 = ₹382.50.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹382.50.**
